text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kenyan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Preliminary post-mortem report on Nairobi University student leader Solomon Muruli indicates fire was cause of death.
- Man believed to have masterminded Kenya's biggest bank robbery charged in Nairobi court.
- Manager with Nairobi forex bureau flees Kenya with 5.4 million shillings ($98,000) in foreign currency.
- United States, Japan and European Union express concern over inflammatory remarks by opposition leader Kenneth Matiba against Asian community.
- Kenya's judiciary resolves to fight land-grabbing and destruction, pollution of environment.
- Assistant minister in office of president says senior police officers implicated in death of student leader Muruli cannot be arrested because of insufficient evidence.
- Kenyan Chief Justice Abdul Cockar instructs judges not to attend seminars if agenda is unknown by his office.
- Government will deploy neighbourhood vigilantes (home guards) along Kenya's international borders.
